# Back Safety and Injury Prevention Training

> 1-hour online course on how the back works, common back injuries and their causes, and how to prevent and manage them through the hierarchy of controls, proper lifting, posture, fitness and stress reduction. Aligned with OSHA and NIOSH guidelines and the OSHA General Duty Clause. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Basis: OSHA and NIOSH guidelines; OSHA General Duty Clause
- Duration: about 1 hour; 2 lessons plus final exam
- Credits: 0.1 CEU
- Price: $29.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Group formats (minimum 10): virtual instructor-led $199/person; client-site in-person $750/person; SCORM packages available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device, audio narration; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 36 months; refresher recommended every three years
- Prerequisites: none

## Who it is for
Workers in physically demanding jobs (manufacturing, construction, healthcare, warehousing, transportation), office workers, and anyone who wants better back health.

## Lessons
1. Understanding the Risks and Causes of Back Injuries
2. Preventing and Managing Back Injuries
